verdict.rationale: Navan documents its own Expense REST API with retrieval and batch-update endpoints across the expense surface, plus a hosted MCP server. The MCP server is framed around querying spend and travel data, and the API is partner-gated, so nothing shows UI parity across travel booking, policy and approval workflows, or card management. missing for 10: travel booking/changing/cancellation via API, write access through MCP, policy/approval workflow management via API, card management write operations, an OpenAPI spec, ungated access, any explicit parity statement, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: retrieval and update endpoints across the expense surface, custom-field management, receipts, and webhooks.
